turns: 整机设备的BOM所有子件及单台总用量是多少？
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(parent_id, child_id, total_qty, level) AS (SELECT b.parent_material_id, b.child_material_id, b.qty_per_parent, 1 FROM bom b WHERE b.parent_material_id = 'M001' UNION ALL SELECT bt.child_id, b.child_material_id, bt.total_qty * b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bom_tree bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.child_id) SELECT bt.child_id AS material_id, m.material_name, ROUND(SUM(bt.total_qty), 4) AS total_qty, MIN(bt.level) AS first_level FROM bom_tree bt JOIN material m ON m.material_id = bt.child_id GROUP BY bt.child_id, m.material_name ORDER BY first_level, bt.child_id

turns: 订单ORD-1005的物料齐套率是多少？
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bt(root_id, parent_id, qty, level) AS (SELECT oi.material_id, oi.material_id, oi.qty, 0 FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = 'ORD-1002' UNION ALL SELECT bt.root_id, b.child_material_id, bt.qty * b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.parent_id), req AS (SELECT material_id, SUM(qty) AS required_qty FROM (SELECT oi.material_id, oi.qty FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = 'ORD-1002' AND oi.material_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT parent_material_id FROM bom) UNION ALL SELECT bt.parent_id AS material_id, bt.qty FROM bt WHERE bt.level > 0) GROUP BY material_id), sup AS (SELECT m.material_id, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) FROM inventory i WHERE i.material_id = m.material_id), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(po.qty) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.material_id = m.material_id AND po.status = 'in_transit'), 0) AS supply_qty FROM material m) SELECT r.material_id, m.material_name, r.required_qty, s.supply_qty, ROUND(MIN(1.0, s.supply_qty * 1.0 / r.required_qty), 4) AS fill_rate FROM req r JOIN material m ON m.material_id = r.material_id JOIN sup s ON s.material_id = r.material_id ORDER BY fill_rate ASC, r.material_id
